dict.string: Trailhead Cambridge shows where you are on the trail and measures your hike while you walk.
Trailhead Cambridge keeps tracking your hike with the phone locked in your pocket. Location is only recorded while a hike is tracking, and it never leaves your phone in this test build.
Trailhead Cambridge uses the motion sensors (pedometer and barometer) to measure your steps, distance and climbing alongside GPS, so the two can be compared.
